verse.verse_2: By the night when it darkeneth,
verse.verse_3: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.
verse.verse_4: And the Hereafter is indeed better Unto thee than the life present.
verse.verse_5: And presently thy Lord shall give Unto thee so that thou shalt be be well-pleased.
verse.verse_6: Found He not thee an orphan, so He sheltered thee?
verse.verse_7: And He found thee wandering, so He guided thee,
verse.verse_8: And He found thee destitute, so He enriched thee.
verse.verse_9: Wherefore as to the orphan, be thou not Unto him overbearing.
verse.verse_10: And as to the beggar, chide thou him not.
verse.verse_11: And as to the favour of thine Lord discourse thou thereof.
